name: react-microfrontend-workspace
description: React Microfrontend Architecture (Host, Products, Cart) using Webpack Module Federation

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd host && npm install && cd ../products && npm install && cd ../cart && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "HOST,PRODUCTS,CART" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:host" "npm run start:products" "npm run start:cart"
scripts.build: concurrently "cd host && npm run build" "cd products && npm run build" "cd cart && npm run build"

author: React Developer
